# LunaPrompts Contest Solutions

luna_prompts_contest_solutions is a prompt reference that documents LunaPrompts contest solutions for people learning prompt engineering.

## Canonical pages

- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/luna_prompts_contest_solutions
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/luna_prompts_contest_solutions/blob/master/README.md
- Contest index: https://lunaprompts.com/contests
- Challenge index: https://lunaprompts.com/challenges
- Latest solutions: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/luna_prompts_contest_solutions/tree/master/2025_week45

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mikaeltorni/luna_prompts_contest_solutions.git
cd luna_prompts_contest_solutions
find 2025_week45 -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort
```

## Scope

This is a documentation and prompt-example collection. It records contest
placements, test counts, token counts, models, and links to stored solutions;
it is not the LunaPrompts website or a prompt execution service.
